basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old bedroom DJ from Manchester, UK. I've been dabbling in music production and DJing ever since I stumbled upon a used Denon MC4000 at a garage sale. By day, I work as a software developer, which allows me to afford my gear and fuel my passion for music. When I'm not coding or mixing tracks, I enjoy exploring new subreddits, especially those related to tech and education. I'm single, and I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work or during weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and I've been self-teaching myself DJing over the last year. My knowledge mainly stems from online forums, YouTube tutorials, and experimenting with equipment I buy second-hand. I also love keeping up with the latest technology trends, which I incorporate into my DJ setup.
